1.

Thou gentle, patient One, Thy meekness teaches me, That I Thy yoke may take upon me And find rest there.

2.

O Jesus, Thou art sufficient To fill soul and mind: Before Thee all sorrow and anxiety flee, And Thou Thyself art now mine.

3.

Ah, fix my heart’s gaze Upon Thee more and more, That, fully satisfied with Thy beauty, I may see no other.
